Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Bow before the rulers of the room, royally rendered by rockstar artist Peter Diamond. This court of Commander favorites is sure to wow tables and crush games as quickly as you can say, “Off with their heads!” Before you say something like, “Arcanis isn’t a royal,” if you look at his Tenth Edition flavor text his origins are shrouded in mystery, so now we’re pulling back the curtain and saying he’s definitely a royal. Maybe a duke? We asked the Worldbuilding team and it’s canon now—someone update the wiki. Either way, these stunning figures are a stalwart addition any deck or collection—grab yours today!

Contents:
• 1x Borderless Brimaz, King of Oreskos
• 1x Borderless Arcanis the Omnipotent
• 1x Borderless Queen Marchesa
• 1x Borderless Savra, Queen of the Golgari
